Give to Physics and Astronomy
Modern science depends on interactive, vertical teams — undergraduates, graduate students, postdoctoral fellows and faculty — working together to address compelling and exciting questions about our world. To recruit the very best people, we must offer competitive endowed faculty chairs and graduate and postdoctoral fellowships.
If the Department of Physics and Astronomy is to excel well into the future, we must provide funding to develop future-oriented research through innovation and excellence funds.
If you have any questions or would like to learn more about opportunities to support the Department of Physics and Astronomy, please contact the School of Natural Sciences at 713-348-3350 or nsci@rice.edu.
